# Administrative Systems

This area groups the foundational administrative and reporting frameworks that underpin the Danish acute surgery database. It covers the national civil registration systems used for patient identification and data linkage, as well as the official guidelines for reporting clinical data to national health registers, ensuring the administrative accuracy required for cross-sectional quality measurements.

## Pages

- [[topics/administrative-systems/danish-civil-registration/index|Danish Civil Registration]] — Key administrative identifiers, clinical pathways, and reporting frameworks, including the national personal identification number and official guidelines for the National Patient Register.
